# meetstream CLI map

The CLI for agent users: workflows with the API calls under them, then every command and flag. Catalog from CLI 1.1.0-dev; released CLI is 1.0.1. Commands marked **pre-release** are not in 1.0.1 yet: do not tell users they can run them until a release has them.

Sources: cli v1.1.0-dev df20d967; cli_released v1.0.1 2e108d8d. Latest docs: https://docs.meetstream.ai/llms.txt (append `.md` to any page).

## Contents

- [Rules](#rules)
- [Workflows](#workflows)
- [Commands](#commands)

## Rules

- Always pass `--json --no-input`; parse stdout; human text goes to stderr.
- Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` runtime or API error, `130` interrupted, `2` usage error or not signed in, `3` not ready or not available, `4` transcript failed.
- Errors with `--json`: {"error": {"message", "hint", "exit_code"}}. Follow the `hint`.
- Sign in with `meetstream login` (browser). Never ask for a key in the chat.

## Workflows

| Workflow | CLI | API calls | Events and results |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sign in and check | login · auth status · doctor · balance | OAuth sign-in; GET /api/v1/bots; GET /api/v1/billing/balance (404 until enabled) | none |
| Send a bot | join <url> --transcription <provider> --follow | POST /api/v1/bots/create_bot (+ Idempotency-Key); GET /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/status | bot.joining → bot.in_waiting_room → bot.inmeeting → bot.recording |
| Live transcript | join --live-transcription <provider> · listen --tunnel | create_bot with live_transcription_required.webhook_url and one *_streaming provider | unsigned POSTs with no event key; no post-call transcript |
| Act in the meeting | bots say · bots show-image · bots hand | POST send_message · send_image · send_command | 409 before bot.inmeeting; 30 commands per minute per bot |
| Remove the bot | bots remove | GET\|POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/remove_bot; GET stop_status | bot.leaving → event bot.stopped (cause in bot_event) |
| After the call | transcript · recordings · bots timeline · bots get | get_transcript (202 pending, 422 final) · get_audio · get_video · get_audio_streams · get_speaker_timeline · /detail | audio.processed · transcription.processed · video.processed · bot.done |
| Transcribe again | transcribe <bot-id> --transcription <provider> | POST /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/transcribe | new transcript_id; transcription.processed or .failed |
| Delete media | bots delete | DELETE /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/delete | data_deletion; status MediaExpired |
| Calendar | calendar connect --own-app · calendar events · calendar schedule · calendar unschedule · calendar auto-join · calendar reschedule · calendar cancel | create_calendar · GET /calendar/events · POST\|DELETE /calendar/schedule/{event_id} · auto-schedule/enable · PATCH\|DELETE /calendar/scheduled_bots/{bot_id} | bot.scheduled; bot.error when a scheduled bot is rejected |
| Zoom | join --zoom-obf-url \| --zoom-zak-url | create_bot with zoom.obf_url / zoom.zak_url (the customer's Zoom app is always required) | bot.recording_permission_allowed / _denied |
| Signed-in bots | logins teams · logins google | teams-login-domains · teams-logins · google-login-domains · google-logins | 429 when every login is busy; 409 for a busy pinned login |
| MIA voice agent | mia apply · setup --mode hosted · setup --mode byok · join --agent-config | GET\|POST\|PUT\|DELETE /api/v1/mia; create_bot with agent_config_id | agent_error |
| Local webhooks | listen --forward-to · trigger · mock | none (loopback) | production envelopes, no charge |
| Anything else | api <path> -X <method> -d <json> | any endpoint, with the CLI sign-in | as documented |
| Agent setup | ai install · mcp add · commands --json | none | writes the skills and the MCP entry |
